title: DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies
abstract: arXiv:2610.00317v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models increasingly rely on action experts that generate short action chunks under receding-horizon control. While chunk-level training is convenient across robot embodiments, it optimizes local action likelihood without explicitly accounting for long-horizon task success. Sequence-level reinforcement learning can address this limitation, but typically requires policy rollouts and closed-loop interaction, which are costly for real-robot manipulation. We introduce DriftOPD, a teacher-free, rollout-free framework for sequence-level on-policy distillation of continuous VLA action experts. We show that the sequence-level reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence decomposes into a chunk-level reverse-KL term and a future-potential term that captures the long-horizon effect of the current action. DriftOPD optimizes these two terms using a one-step drifting objective and a Q-function critic learned from offline dem

translated_title: DriftOPD：面向单步VLA策略的序列级反向KL散度蒸馏
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型越来越依赖于在滚动时域控制下生成短动作片段的动作专家。虽然片段级训练在不同机器人本体之间使用方便，但它优化的只是局部动作似然，而没有明确考虑长时程任务的成功。序列级强化学习可以解决这一局限性，但通常需要策略回放和闭环交互，这对于真实机器人操作而言成本高昂。我们提出了DriftOPD，这是一个无需教师、无需回放的框架，用于连续VLA动作专家的序列级在线策略蒸馏。我们证明了序列级反向Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度可以分解为一个片段级反向KL项和一个捕捉当前动作长时程影响的未来势能项。DriftOPD使用单步漂移目标函数和从离线示教数据中学习的Q函数评论家来优化这两项。
tldr: DriftOPD提出了一种无需教师和回放的序列级在线策略蒸馏框架，通过将序列级反向KL散度分解为片段级反向KL项与未来势能项，实现了对连续VLA动作专家的单步蒸馏训练，兼顾了长时程任务成功而无需昂贵的真实机器人闭环交互。
en_tdlr: DriftOPD is a teacher-free, rollout-free framework for sequence-level on-policy distillation of continuous VLA action experts, which decomposes sequence-level reverse-KL divergence into a chunk-level reverse-KL term and a future-potential term, enabling one-step distillation that accounts for long-horizon task success without costly real-robot closed-loop interaction.
